work.abstract_text: Using Mathar's inverse-root theorem (2021, Theorem 2 and Example 4) and Cigler's determinant theorem (2002 volume, Theorem 2), we give explicit proofs of Mathar's three-term conjecture in OEIS A128057, revision 11, FORMULA (2 December 2014), by coefficient pairing, and Barker's empirical Hankel generating function in OEIS A128056, revision 5, FORMULA (27 June 2013), by a block determinant, respectively. The A128057 recurrence holds for every n >= 2. A polynomial identity gives the corresponding three-term recurrence for (u+v*x)/sqrt(1+c*x^2) with arbitrary rational parameters. The same determinant argument proves Barker's quotient generating function, gives the unsigned and shifted Hankel transforms, and corrects related sign, parity and indexing statements.

authors.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore
authors.name: Wenlin Zhang

work.title: Explicit proofs of Mathar's recurrence and Barker's Hankel formulas from Mathar's and Cigler's theorems
